7.11.5.1 Initialize NvM Data
Reprogramming of an ECU with an updated DEM configuration may lead to inconsis-
tencies of the integrity and validity of Dem related data stored in NvM. (e.g. Ids stored
in non-volatile Dem related data might not match to the reprogrammed DEM configu-
ration)
Dem is providing the functions Dem_InitAllNvmBlocks and Dem_InitAllNvm-
BlocksGetResult to support a non-AUTOSAR-specified handler/manager to resolve
those validity issues by initializing all Dem related NvM data blocks.
[SWS_Dem_01420] Acceptance of Requests During the Valid Initialization Se-
quence
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04211
⌈If the function Dem_InitAllNvmBlocks is called after Dem_PreInit and before
Dem_Init, the Dem shall accept the request and return E_OK.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01421]
Handling of Requests Outside the Valid Initialization Se-
quence
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04211
⌈If the function Dem_InitAllNvmBlocks is called before Dem_PreInit or after
Dem_Init, the Dem shall not accept the request and shall return E_NOT_OK.⌋
[SWS_Dem_01422] Initialization and Storage Actions for Accepted Non-Volatile
Memory Requests
Upstream requirements: RS_Diag_04211
⌈If a Dem_InitAllNvmBlocks request was accepted before Dem_Init, the Dem
shall do the following actions during execution of Dem_Init:
• Reset the volatile data buffers of all the Dem related NvM data blocks to initial
values.
• Trigger an immediate NvM storage request to store the updated volatile data
buffers in NvM.
